explanation: Sawin Lemmas 11–12 / Remarks Prop. 2.3: there is a fixed infinite set Q of primes q ≡ 1 (mod 4) and a root-discriminant bound such that totally real fields of arbitrarily large degree exist in which every q ∈ Q splits completely. Complete splitting is encoded as [F:ℚ] distinct maximal ideals of 𝓞 F containing q, which is equivalent. The quantifier order (Q before F) is the essential point and is correct. A Lean proof is linked. Faithful.
